2. Does the Public Sector Undertaking's legislative enactment / ordinance provision conform to Article 353 (Effect of Proclamation of Emergency (Unitary Transformation))?

Bommai v. Union of India (1994) on the factual record.

3. How does S.R. Bommai v. Union of India (1994) govern the constitutional validity and relief in this matter?
